description: HEART READER robustness + the live biometric panel legend (FOUNDER_WORKLIST.md items #28, #29, and the heart-reader complaints in the user request). The founder loves the heart reader and the live biometric panel and wants them KEPT — but the reader is fragile and the panel lacks explanation. Make the camera-based heart-rate (rPPG) reading resilient on phones so it does not show broken/blank/implausible values, and never instructs the person to serve the technology (Immutable Principle 11: 'the technology adapts or quietly steps aside — the person is never corrected'). Add a legend explaining the trend sparkline on the admin biometric panel, and offer a non-brown palette accent for it.
steps: Study the heart-reading code in core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py: the rPPG estimator (~line 4062-4165, computeBPM/autocorrelation, heartBPM smoothing, plausibility band 40-170 bpm), the on-page heart chip (#heart-chip ~line 4173, #heart-num, #heart-beat), the staleness handling (window._heartStale ~line 3911), the phone chip CSS (~line 766), the bridge/br-bpm display (~line 3379-3413), and the reporting call reportHeart()/api/bio/ping (~line 4714) and admin /api/admin/bio/live.

HEART READER ROBUSTNESS: harden the reader so it degrades gracefully instead of glitching. Ensure that when the signal is weak, the face is not well lit, or the estimate is implausible/stale, the chip shows a calm resting state (e.g. the heart glyph without a wrong number) rather than a broken/blank bar or a jumping impossible value. Keep the existing 40-170 bpm plausibility clamp and staleness reset; make sure a lost signal cleanly zeroes rather than freezing on a stale number. Under Principle 11, NEVER add any instruction telling the person to 'find better light', 'lean in', 'hold still', or 'allow access and try again' — if it cannot read them as they are, it adapts or quietly steps aside. Verify any existing camera tips (#hr-distance-tip, #il-light-tip) comply; soften or remove any that instruct the person to serve the sensor.

Confirm the heart reader stays fully client-side and privacy-safe: only anonymous derived values (bpm, tier, calm state) are sent (reportHeart ~line 4714), never raw video frames. Do not change that posture.

LIVE BIOMETRIC PANEL (admin) — item #28: KEEP it. Add a short, plain-language legend that explains what the trend sparkline shows (e.g. 'each dot is a recent heart-rate reading; a downward slope means the room is settling'). Place the legend adjacent to the sparkline in the /admin biometric panel.

Item #28/#29 palette: offer a NON-brown accent color for the biometric panel and its sparkline (e.g. a calm teal/green), so it is not lost in the all-brown theme. This is a targeted accent on the bio panel, coordinated with the broader palette work in FEAT-005 (do not conflict — use a shared accent value if FEAT-005 introduces one).
Run the full validation gate after changes.
acceptance_criteria: When the camera signal is weak/absent/stale, the heart chip shows a calm neutral state rather than a broken blank bar or an implausible jumping number; a lost signal cleanly zeroes.
No text anywhere in the heart-reading flow instructs the person to adjust themselves for the sensor (no 'better light', 'lean in', 'hold still', 'try again').
Only anonymous derived heart values are transmitted; no raw frames.
The admin live biometric panel is retained and now has a plain-language legend explaining the trend sparkline, rendered next to it.
The biometric panel/sparkline uses a non-brown accent color.
The full validation gate (py_compile, check_frontend with 0 failures, lang parity, smoke) passes.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/innerlight && python -m py_compile core/axiom_harmony_unified_app.py && echo COMPILE_OK

python - <<'PY'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'core')
import axiom_harmony_unified_app as a
html=a.app.test_client().get('/').get_data(as_text=True)
print('heart-chip present:', 'heart-chip' in html)
PY
findings: IMPLEMENTED. (1) Heart chip (#heart-chip ~line 4155) hardened for graceful degradation: it now only appears once the camera is actually on (window._camOn), and when the reading is weak/absent/stale/implausible it degrades to a calm resting state — the heart glyph gently beating with NO misleading number (heart-num set to a hidden non-breaking space) instead of freezing on a stale/wrong value; a lost signal (not fresh) cleanly zeroes heartBPM/window._heartBPM. The existing 40-170 bpm plausibility clamp and the >20-tick staleness reset were kept. (2) Principle 11 audit: no instruction to serve the sensor exists in the heart flow. The distance/light tips (#hr-distance-tip, #il-light-tip) were already REMOVED at runtime by existing code (distanceNudge removes any leftover tip; low-light auto-brightens via adaptive gamma rather than asking for light) — verified and left intact; no new instructive text added. grep for 'better light/lean in/come closer/hold still/try again/allow access' shows the only heart-flow matches are the compliant comments and the public statement at line ~10011 affirming we never correct the person. (3) Privacy posture unchanged: reportHeart/_bioPingPayload still send only anonymous derived values (sid, bpm, tier, base, state, face, cam, hasheart) — no raw frames. (4) Admin biometric panel KEPT and given a plain-language legend adjacent to the sparkline (a small teal trend-line icon + copy: 'Each dot is one recent heart-rate reading, oldest on the left, newest on the right. A line drifting downward means the body is settling...'). (5) Added shared CSS var --il-bio-accent:#5fc9a8 (calm teal) in the admin :root (~line 13508); the sparkline polyline+dots and the legend border/accent now use var(--il-bio-accent), replacing the brown #e8a34c stroke, so the panel is no longer lost in the all-warm theme. Named for reuse by FEAT-005 palette work. GATE: py_compile OK (no SyntaxWarning); check_frontend 38 blocks / 0 failures; lang parity PARITY_OK (untouched; pre-existing 0/121 page-bake bootstrap note is informational, script returns success); check_crisis_safety CRISIS_OK; check_hybrid_fallback HYBRID_OK; verify.sh => 'VERIFIED: safe to serve'. Confirmed via test_client that /admin renders the legend + --il-bio-accent and that heart-chip is present on /.
